# Stoatworks Flasher

> Firmware onto our hardware, or any ESP32, from a browser

A browser page that puts firmware on Stoatworks hardware over USB: the CANary, nanODE and Cuckoo, or any ESP32 board with an image of your own. Pick a device and a release, or give it a release zip, a whole-flash .bin or the parts of an ESP-IDF build. Every file is identified by what's in it and checked before anything's written, and every write is read back and verified. You don't need a toolchain or a driver, and nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

Every firmware release is also a direct download: a release zip (which this page and Burrow both read) and a whole-flash .bin per variant, to write at 0x0 with any ESP32 flashing tool.

It's a Stoatworks Labs web tool: free, and it runs in a web browser.

## Links

- [Stoatworks Flasher, the app](https://flasher.stoatworks-labs.com/): runs in the browser, free
- [Web tool page](https://stoatworks-labs.com/web-tools/flasher/)
